source.book: 据《史记》卷一百零九《李将军列传》改编。
source.excerpt: 廣出獵，見草中石，以爲虎而射之，中石沒鏃，視之石也。因復更射之，終不能復入石矣。廣所居郡聞有虎，嘗自射之。及居右北平射虎，虎騰傷廣，廣亦竟射殺之。

Target canvas 1024×990. Thin straight cream gutters about 6px, no outer margin, no header/footer, no inset, no merged cells. Each cell is a LANDSCAPE illustration. NO TEXT, captions, numbers, letters, calligraphy, speech balloons, watermark anywhere. Documents must be blank.
STYLE REFERENCE: attached image is only the established visual style, NOT story content/layout/text. Match exaggerated expressive ADULT folk-art characters, larger heads with angular noses/eyebrows and spare fine BLACK ink contours, FLAT matte indigo/ochre/cinnabar/green color blocks, restrained subtle paper grain, cream negative space and simple geometric backgrounds, early Shanghai animation / 1950s Chinese small-picture books. No realistic facial modeling, elaborate brocade, modern anime, 3D, glossy digital painting or dense brown noise. Preserve ancient Chinese clothing and props. No props/events copied from the reference.
CHARACTERS AND INVARIANTS: 李广中年短须深青袍皮护腕，持古弓；灰色石头隐在草中，轮廓似虎但始终石头；无真正老虎，无发光箭，箭尖入石不穿透。
Scenes, exactly in this order (Chinese captions here describe events to ILLUSTRATE; never render their text):
1. 李广外出打猎，来到草木丛生的地方。
2. 他看见草里的石头，以为那是一只虎。
